sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B — vllm-ascend - docs.vllm.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B # Introduction # Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a sparse MoE model in the Qwen3.6 family. It has 35B total parameters with about 3B activated per token, and uses the same hybrid attention architecture (GDN + full attention) as Qwen3.5. Deployment on vLLM Ascend follows the same pattern as other Qwen3.5-style MoE models.
